issues.description: Ingest clears warnings/stats but never clears results, so removed input rows remain in the database forever.
Ingest commits row-by-row, so a later parser crash leaves a partially updated database.
Harness B parsing assumes JSONL records and metrics are dicts, causing AttributeError on arrays or scalar metrics.
Malformed Harness C XML raises ParseError and aborts the entire ingest instead of recording a warning.
Score parsing accepts non-finite values such as NaN, which later fails at SQLite insertion instead of being validated.
Required identifiers are allowed to be empty, causing distinct missing-ID rows to overwrite each other via the unique key.
Harness A reads but does not validate the CSV header, so wrong column orders are silently misinterpreted.
Report mode creates a new empty SQLite database for a missing path instead of surfacing a likely operator error.
Fixture generation recursively deletes any existing target directory without path safety checks.
Tests cover only generated fixture behavior and miss malformed input, stale re-ingest, and partial-write regressions.
